QR encoder adapted from qrcode-terminal 0.12.0, vendor/QRCode.
Upstream encoder: QRCode for JavaScript, Copyright (c) 2009 Kazuhiko Arase, MIT license.
Source: https://github.com/gtanner/qrcode-terminal/tree/v0.12.0/vendor/QRCode
Upstream source header and the qrcode-terminal Apache 2.0 license are retained.
Local changes: CommonJS converted to ES modules; UTF-8 TextEncoder bytes and UTF-8 ECI 26 included in capacity calculation and payload.
